purpose: Portable RLinf-MiBoT Track B deployment bundle, prepared before the new GPU server exists.

gates.detail: docker/Dockerfile (CUDA 12.1.1 base + digest, torch/flash-attn pinned, RLinf cloned at pinned commit). `docker build --check` clean.
run.sh + docker-compose.yml (server/client style, build/smoke/ppo-smoke/ode-eval/shell).
configs/requirements-rlinf.{txt,lock}; build args TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST/MAX_JOBS/RLINF_COMMIT.
.env.example: only path/host/GPU/port/revision placeholders, no secrets.
bootstrap.sh: preflight -> pin RLinf -> build -> validate mounts -> smoke; stops before training.
preflight.sh: driver/GPU/VRAM/docker/toolkit/disk/RAM/ports/network/mounts; never touches host drivers.
src/smoke.py: imports/cuda/egl/robocasa/checkpoint/volume gates -> smoke_report.json.
src/mibot_adapter.py + src/rlinf_env.py: model/obs/12-D decode/velocity/pi-RL sampler/reward/RLinf-reg interfaces; reuse verified pirl_flow_sde.py + flow_policy.py + reward.py by import.
configs/ppo_smoke.yaml (adapter-only, 1 iter, epochs>=2) + configs/ode_eval.yaml (noise=0). Long training disabled by guards.
deploy/README.md with required inputs, deploy/smoke/ppo/resume/rollback commands and expected outputs.
tests/test_static.py: 31 checks PASS (imports, config parse, guard, pins, secret scan, env-placeholder scan).
bash -n clean on bootstrap.sh/preflight.sh/run.sh.
both Hydra YAMLs parse; entry-point dry runs (no GPU) write reports and hit the NEEDS_SERVER seam.
`docker build --check` on docker/Dockerfile: no warnings. .dockerignore keeps context minimal.
no embedded secrets / no absolute server-specific paths (test_static).
flash-attn build requires an NVIDIA GPU host + toolkit; validated statically here (local daemon has no GPU). Build on the new server.
CUDA tensor + EGL render smoke require the GPU.
CloseBlenderLid reset/step render needs assets mount + EGL on the server.
MiBoT 5B load + processor + config hash record needs GPU + /checkpoint mount.
noise=0 == checkpoint deterministic ODE bit-for-bit; in-process GPU gate.
stored-vs-recomputed log-prob ratio==1 before update; GPU gate.
register MiBoT against the pinned RLinf API (explicit NotImplementedError seam) — wire on server.
one short adapter-only PPO update + checkpoint resume; GPU gate.
deterministic ODE eval on fixed seeds, base vs trained; sim + GPU gate.

required_server_inputs: SSH host/alias for the new server
GPU model + count + NVIDIA driver version
host paths for RoboCasa assets and the Xiaomi checkpoint mounts
whether outbound network is allowed (else pre-seed RLinf clone + base image)
